sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong leaders and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches. This should be a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back from their latest defeat.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to apply pressure on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) host Eccleshall (5th) in an intriguing clash between two of the division's stronger performers, though both have shown recent inconsistency. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good form with three straight wins, visit Wednesfield Community in a match-up between sides separated by six points. Bilston Town (6th, on a three-game winning run) travel to Foley Meir, while Barnton (7th, unbeaten in their last two) host Shawbury United—a side in alarming form with six consecutive losses. In the lower reaches, struggling Crewe host Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle of two of the division's weakest sides, and Brereton Social welcome basement club Widnes Town. Market Drayton Town, winless in their last two, travel to face in-form New Mills.
